rows.what_the_ink_shows: In the displayed induced-topos identification, the left factor has Delta/X under a large hat. In the Hom argument at the right, the ink has only Delta with a small superscript circle, then a separator and Ens; no /X appears there. See crops/136_scan058_L329.jpg.
rows.note: Preserve the written \underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(\Delta^\circ\,\mathrm{Ens}), which the original already has. The row’s intended expression is Hom((Delta/X)^op, Ens); that adds symbols absent from this display. The subsequent prose on the full page does write (Delta/X)^circ, but that does not authorize filling the omission in the display.
